# permitio_resource (Data Source)

Reads a resource by its key, with its actions and attributes, such as one that Terraform does not manage. Only `key` selects the resource; every other attribute holds what Permit returns.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    permitio = {
      source = "permitio/permit-io"
    }
  }
}

data "permitio_resource" "document" {
  key = "document"
}

# A role that may take every action the document resource has.
resource "permitio_role" "document_admin" {
  key  = "document_admin"
  name = "Document admin"
  permissions = [
    for action in keys(data.permitio_resource.document.actions) :
    "${data.permitio_resource.document.key}:${action}"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) The key of the resource to read.

### Optional

- `actions` (Attributes Map) The actions of the resource, by action key. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))
- `attributes` (Attributes Map) The attributes of the resource, by attribute key. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes))
- `description` (String) The description of the resource, or null when it has none. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.
- `name` (String) The name of the resource. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.
- `urn` (String) The URN of the resource, or null when it has none. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the resource was created.
- `environment_id` (String) The ID of the environment the resource belongs to.
- `id` (String) The ID Permit assigns to the resource.
- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization the resource belongs to.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project the resource belongs to.
- `updated_at` (String) When the resource was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Optional:

- `description` (String) The description of the action, or null.
- `name` (String) The name of the action.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The ID Permit assigns to the action.


<a id="nestedatt--attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes`

Required:

- `type` (String) The type of the attribute: `bool`, `number`, `string`, `time`, `array` or `json`.

Optional:

- `description` (String) The description of the attribute, or null.
